component.name: SSD Sentinel
component.summary: Storage diagnostics, io_uring benchmarking, surface repair, tiering, and data recovery
Disk sağlığı tanılama, hız testi, yüzey onarımı, katmanlama ve veri kurtarma

description.p: SSD Sentinel is a native Linux storage diagnostics and engineering suite built in pure Rust. It inspects NVMe/SATA/SAS health via sysfs, UDisks2, and smartmontools, benchmarks I/O via io_uring and O_DIRECT, performs targeted surface verification and repair, optimizes Linux storage tuning, tracks smart tiering, cleans rebuildable developer caches, and recovers files from XDG Trash, snapshots, NTFS $MFT, and raw sectors.
